source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 1Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). Phillip Life Assurance. Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; printed folio + 11 = file page). CAR disclosure p.1-3, review report (Deloitte) from p.4. Units differ: the SCI (p.7) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision: separate statements). The separate statements account for the subsidiary by the equity method; its share of loss is included in other income (net), as in FY2025. The insurance notes are common to both. Note 5 (columns non-PAA 6.1 / PAA 6.2 / total; 3 months): revenue p.16, expenses p.17; incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward (note 6.1, reconciliation by measurement component, 31 มีนาคม 2569) p.22-23; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business p.25 (3 months); totals used (the onerous column shows a CSM of 18,929, as in FY2025). RA release uses note 5, equal to the AOC RA. Insurance service result is a loss this quarter (onerous losses 174,535). Other expense = finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
